Shipment-sequencing product gaps (backlogit code side; OPTIONAL, deferred per spike 001-SP). Make multi-shipment ordering clean for long-running dark-factory runs. Candidates: (a) shipment-scoped queue_position so ordering does not renumber across the combined default-status queue view (queue_position is a global integer across all item types today: internal/core/queue.go buildQueueOrderClause + MoveInQueue; custom_fields.queue_position is not settable via update_item). (b) First-class shipment->shipment blocking-order affordance for `queue view --type shipment --status queued` (item_deps already supports generic edges via AddDependency, but dep_type collapses to blocks on sync: internal/core/dependencies.go). (c) Meaningful shipment priority so the queue secondary sort is well-defined (queued shipments commonly carry no priority). (d) Optional NON-authoritative ship_sequence audit surface (spike Option D) recording a dark-mode activation plan; build only after a real multi-shipment run shows activation evidence is insufficient. NOTE: the pure orchestrator/policy/playbook hardening does NOT need any of these and belongs in autoharness templates; this entry is only the optional backlogit product enhancements. Ref: docs/decisions/2026-07-29-ship-sequence-manifest-spike.md, spike 001-SP, P-017.

BUG/ENHANCEMENT: core.ShipShipment cascade over-archives ancestor features for partial-feature shipments. featureScopeRoots walks parent_id up from each manifest item and collectArchiveCandidateIDs appends every ancestor feature unconditionally (no terminal-children gate), so shipping a sub-shipment always archives the covering feature (plus any terminal unshipped siblings; nonterminal siblings are detached by returnUnreleasedFeatureItems and excluded from archive candidates). P-015 already mandates single-artifact safe-close (never cascade) for partial-feature shipments as the PROCEDURAL guard. Durable PRODUCT fix must survive the hard case: a descendant-only CheckChildrenTerminal gate is insufficient because (a) planned-but-unharvested units (e.g. 106-F F1/F4/F5/F6) have no descendant records, and (b) returnUnreleasedFeatureItems detaches harvested nonterminal descendants before collectArchiveCandidateIDs. Options: (1) archive strictly by explicit shipment membership; (2) a durable keep-open lifecycle flag on the covering feature; (3) enforce P-015 in code so ship_shipment refuses/degrades to safe-close when a shipment is partial-feature. Also fix agent drift: .ship.agent.md Step 6.1.b still says call backlogit_ship_shipment; add a P-015 partial-feature branch. Evidence: internal/core/shipment_lifecycle.go collectArchiveCandidateIDs/featureScopeRoots/returnUnreleasedFeatureItems. See docs/compound/2026-07-31-p015-single-artifact-safe-close-for-partial-feature-shipments.md.
